title: A Price With a Lid: What Japan's Mandatory Carbon Market Costs a Steel Plant and a Coal Plant
detail: Japan's emissions trading went mandatory in April 2026 with a ¥1,700–¥4,300 corridor; the ClimRisk engine compares that lid with NGFS carbon prices at two steelworks and a coal power station.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
